brief.zh: 没有任何已知，证出「(下雨 → (刮风 → 地湿)) → ((下雨 → 刮风) → (下雨 → 地湿))」。
brief.en: With nothing given, prove “(it rains → (it is windy → the ground is wet)) → ((it rains → it is windy) → (it rains → the ground is wet))”.

hint.zh: 数一数最外层的 →：三个框，一个套一个，依次假设三个「如果」的部分。
hint.en: Count the outermost →s: three boxes, one inside the next, assuming the three “if” parts in turn.

hint.zh: 最里面有了「下雨」，把两句外层假设各套用一次，再把结果互相套用。
hint.en: With “it rains” innermost, apply each outer assumption to it once, then apply the results to each other.

t.zh: 这句话叫 S，和 K 一起，是只有公理的证明器的全部出发点。它说的是：在同一个条件「下雨」下，也能套用。读出来就是证明：三层假设，三次套用。
t.en: This sentence is called S; with K it is everything a prover with only axioms starts from. It says: under one condition, “it rains”, Apply still works. Read it aloud and you have the proof: three assumptions, three Applies.

after.zh: 现在 K 和 S 都是你证出来的元件，不是规定。
after.en: K and S are now parts you proved, not rules you were handed.
